sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:59881
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2030 of 2023

Applicant :- Shalini Gupta @ Neha
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard the learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned Additional Government
Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing
Case Crime No.126 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 313 I.P.C., 3/4 Dowry Prohibition
Act, 1961 registered at Police Station Kunda, District Pratapgarh.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 21.04.2017, against four
persons, including the applicant, alleging that informant got married to the applicant's brother,
co-accused-Vishal Kumar Gupta on 22.02.2016; that all the accused persons used to harass her for
dowry demand and they forcibly turned her out from her matrimonial home on 27.05.2016.

4.  In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been contended that the Shalini Gupta @ Neha vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128487977/
1 applicant had got married in the year 2019 and she lives in her matrimonial home, she has no criminal history and she has falsely been implicated in the present case because of matrimonial dispute between the informant and her husband.
5.

entities.text: Shalini Gupta @ Neha vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is a woman having no criminal history and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
